smell_validity.evidence: One hardcoded constant (LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL=0, with no configuration path reading it) permanently disables five selectors, and two arms dispatch on a CompareMode member the enum never defines, so no supported use can reach the retired pipeline. The retired features are genuine functionality, not filler, and the rotted enum arm demonstrates retention's real cost, making the boundary from a configurable compat layer unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Dead branches were inserted ahead of live modes in build_match_function, display_result and make_pretty_diff, and an arm naming a nonexistent mode sits between live arms of check_lines_match, so any new comparison mode or rendering change must reason around retired code. Six production files and three orphan imports (compat, json, unicodedata) carry the burden; removal restores single-purpose dispatch chains.

development_plausibility.evidence: The retired features carry real history — yukicoder-style NFKC comparator, downloads.json importer, %n aliasing, old results printout — written in house style (logger, NO_HEADER, pathlib, enum dispatch with assert else). Remaining seams: every arm carries the same retrospective 'removed in 12.0' comment, a somewhat too-uniform annotation pattern for ordinary evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: It states the exact finished state — switches, gated regions, implementations, transitively reachable members, and orphan imports gone — and decisively blocks the costliest near-misses: reintroducing retired enum values and re-adding always-off knobs. Precise stable surfaces (four modes, %s/%e grammar, empty-history semantics, all display modes, test suite) and package scope prevent incomplete cleanup and irrelevant redesign.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five purposes each need a distinct code-supported decision: entry dispatch (restore else handling, delete command body and json import), comparator selection (two different deadness proofs, class deletion, annotated-binding restoration), rendering (transitive helper traced through its sole dead caller), grammar expansion versus parsing (delegation removed versus table-copy stub verified), persistence (keep the return [] empty-history semantics).

localization_burden.evidence: A selector-call grep finds the gated regions, but the check_lines_match arm has no switch: recognizing it requires combining the CompareMode definition with dispatch in another module. Plausible exclusions exist — percentsplit, the snipping-free tokenizer and _replace_whitespace serve both dead and live code — and json/unicodedata removal needs per-file usage checks.

repair_coordination.evidence: Deletion must preserve shared rules: deleting compat.py requires all five import edits together or every subcommand fails at import; the comparator class must disappear with both arms in two files; make_pretty_diff_legacy with both of its call sites. But the areas are independent — history, grammar and dispatch do not interact — and partial failures crash loudly rather than diverging.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: The best uniform operation — excising every compat-gated region plus the switch module and its imports — covers roughly half the locations. The rest (run_legacy_results_command, _render_tokens_legacy, LegacyNormalizingComparator, _load_legacy_v0, json/unicodedata imports) requires per-symbol caller verification with shared helpers correctly kept, and the enum arm needs wholly different reasoning.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Most mis-edits fail loudly: a dangling elif is a syntax error, a kept compat reference crashes at import. One silent path exists: percentformat's gate sits directly above the literal-'%' bookkeeping, so over-broad deletion compiles, passes ordinary %s/%e formats, and KeyErrors only when a format contains '%'. A second unchecked hidden path is not established.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
